what_is_closed: the two standard linearized-GR TT polarizations admit a second-order state (h,Pi) with G=D(h) imposed algebraically
on the LGL diagonal-norm SBP grid, the SAT scheme has the exact energy rate dE/dt=-sum_A(Pi_A,left^2+Pi_A,right^2)<=0
the second-order RHS is algebraically identical to the existing first-order TT SBP-SAT RHS on G=D(h)
right- and left-going Gaussian packets exit with a roundoff-scale energy remainder and RK4 temporal order is verified
the current strong differentiated-target replacement has positive energy-growth directions under both tested LGL-SBP and Chebyshev/Clenshaw-Curtis norms
what_remains_open: this is a physical TT-sector outgoing-wave control, not the full ten-component constraint/physical/gauge GH CPBC system
the constraint and gauge projector sectors, positive-shift u2_A fields, tangential derivatives, corners, variable coefficients, and nonlinear terms remain open
a SAT operator derived for all Rinne constraint/physical/gauge targets is still required before closing full-u1 GH evolution

equation_or_mapping.state: (h_A,Pi_A), A in {+,x}; G_A=D(h_A) is reconstructed algebraically
equation_or_mapping.energy: E=1/2 sum_A(Pi_A^T H Pi_A+G_A^T H G_A)
equation_or_mapping.relation_to_Rinne_physical_target: for q_A=a_A-gamma2*h_A and homogeneous physical data, q_dot=gamma2*Pi implies a_dot=0; the SAT weakly penalizes a_A, and does not implement the full Rinne CPBC

units.unit_lane: geometric c=1 with slab length scale L0=1

major_result.derivation_class: standard linearized-GR TT wave equation plus an SBP-SAT semidiscrete energy identity
major_result.observable: discrete energy rate, incoming characteristic, packet remainder, reduction identity, and temporal convergence
major_result.data_role: analytic and synthetic numerical control; no external data, fitting, or holdout
open_blockers: full first-order GH CPBC energy estimate across constraint, physical, and gauge sectors
positive-shift u2_A, tangential derivatives, corners, variable coefficients, and nonlinear boundary evolution
major_result.dependency_unlocked: none; the Core curved-3+1 parent remains PARTIAL and Gravity remains blocked
major_result.claim_boundary: a second-order reduced TT numerical lane only; not full GH CPBC, continuum well-posedness, Gravity compatibility, or UET closure

next_action: derive a projector-aware SBP-SAT penalty for all ten incoming u1-minus modes and prove its coupled constraint, Weyl, and gauge energy estimate before testing positive-shift u2_A or corners
claim_boundary: This closes only a standard-GR second-order reduced TT control. It does not close the full first-order GH boundary evolution, curved 3+1 parent, Gravity, or UET.
